product_metadata.title: Lodge SCRBRSH Scrub Brush, 10-Inch
features: One Lodge Care Scrub Brush, 10 Inch
Rubber wood handle with a natural lacquer finish
Plastic head with stiff nylon bristles preserve your cookware's finish
description: Our new and improved Lodge Scrub Brush makes short work of cleaning your cast iron or enamel cookware. Features a rubber wood handle with a natural lacquer finish and an ergonomic design for greater comfort. The dense bristles effortlessly clean seasoned cast iron without harming the seasoning. Includes one Lodge Scrub Brush and one plastic bristle protector.
